items.source: The SpEL blocked starts with :#{ and then refers to the given String parameters by name (#pt1). Don’t confuse this with the above Cypher syntax! The SpEL expression concatenates both parameters into one single value that is eventually passed on to the appendix/neo4j-client.adoc#neo4j-client. The SpEL block ends with }.
items.translation: SpEL 阻塞以:#{开头，然后通过名称引用给定的参数（例如#pt1）。 请勿将其与上述 Cypher 语法混淆！ SpEL 表达式将两个参数拼接为一个单一值，该值最终传递给附录/neo4j-client.adoc#neo4j-client。 SpEL 块以}结束。

items.source: SpEL also solves two additional problems. We provide two extensions that allow to pass in a Sort object into custom queries. Remember faq.adoc#custom-queries-with-page-and-slice-examples from custom queries? With the orderBy extension you can pass in a Pageable with a dynamic sort to a custom query:
items.translation: SpEL 还解决了两个额外的问题。我们提供了两个扩展，允许将 `Sort` 对象传入自定义查询中。 还记得关于faq.adoc#custom-queries-with-page-and-slice-examples的自定义查询吗？ 通过 `orderBy` 扩展，您可以将一个带有动态排序的 `Pageable` 对象传入自定义查询：

items.source: Here, the literal value has been used to match dynamically on a Label. If you pass in SomeLabel as a parameter to the method, MATCH (n:SomeLabel) RETURN n will be generated. Ticks have been added to correctly escape values. SDN won’t do this for you as this is probably not what you want in all cases.
items.translation: 此处，literal 值已用于在 Label 上进行动态匹配。 如果将 SomeLabel 作为参数传递给该方法，则会生成 MATCH (n:SomeLabel) RETURN n。已添加转义符以正确转义值。SDN 不会自动执行此操作，因为在所有情况下这可能都不是您想要的行为。

items.source: For more than one value there are allOf and anyOf in place that would render either a & or | concatenated list of all values.
items.translation: 对于多个值，存在 `allOf` 和 `anyOf`，它们会分别渲染为所有值的 `&`（与）或 `|`（或）连接的列表。

items.source: In the example above, if the property foo would be set to bar then the ${foo} block would be resolved to bar.
items.translation: 在上面的示例中，如果属性foo被设置为bar，那么${foo}块将被解析为bar。

items.source: For this the example from above should also contain Movies on the Persons that get returned with the initial Movie.
items.translation: 为此，上面的示例还应包含在初始返回的Movie中带有Movies的Persons。

items.source: Spring Expression Language (SpEL) can be used in custom queries inside :#{}. The colon here refers to a parameter and such an expression should be used where parameters make sense. However, when using our literal extension you can use SpEL expression in places where standard Cypher won’t allow parameters (such as for labels or relationship types). This is the standard Spring Data way of defining a block of text inside a query that undergoes SpEL evaluation.
items.translation: Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 可用于 :#{} 内部的自定义查询中。此处的冒号表示参数，因此此类表达式应仅在参数有意义的地方使用。然而，在使用我们的字面量扩展时，您可以在标准 Cypher 不允许使用参数的位置（例如用于标签或关系类型）使用 SpEL 表达式。这是 Spring Data 定义查询中需经过 SpEL 评估的文本块的标准方式。

items.source: This node has a couple of labels, and it would be rather error prone to repeat them all the time in custom queries: You might forget one or make a typo. We offer the following expression to mitigate this: #{#staticLabels}. Notice that this one does not start with a colon! You use it on repository methods annotated with @Query:
items.translation: 该节点具有多个标签，如果在自定义查询中每次都重复这些标签会非常容易导致错误：你可能会遗漏某个标签或拼写错误。为此，我们提供以下表达式来避免这种情况：#{#staticLabels}。请注意，此表达式不以冒号开头！你可以在带有 @Query 注解的仓库方法中使用它：

items.source: To get the right object(s) back, it is required to collect the relationships and related nodes in the query: MATCH (m:Movie{title: 'The Matrix'})←[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) return m,collect(r),collect(p)
items.translation: 要获取正确的对象，需要在查询中收集关系和相关节点：MATCH (m:Movie{title: 'The Matrix'})←[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) return m,collect(r),collect(p)

items.source: The reduce function allows us to flatten the nodes and relationships from various paths. As a result we will get a tuple similar to Getting one record per root node but with a mixture of relationship types or nodes in the collections.
items.translation: `reduce` 函数允许我们扁平化来自各种路径的节点和关系。因此，我们将得到一个与为每个根节点获取一条记录类似的元组，但其集合中混合了不同类型的关系或节点。

items.source: You do this exactly the same way as in a standard Cypher query issued in the Neo4j Browser or the Cypher-Shell, with the $ syntax (from Neo4j 4.0 on upwards, the old ${foo} syntax for Cypher parameters has been removed from the database).
items.translation: 您执行此操作的方式与在 Neo4j Browser 或 Cypher-Shell 中发出标准 Cypher 查询时完全相同，使用 `$` 语法（从 Neo4j 4.0 开始，旧版用于 Cypher 参数的 `${foo}` 语法已从数据库中移除）。

items.source: A node is represented by a map. The map will always contain __id__ which is the mapped id property. Under __labels__ all labels, static and dynamic, will be available. All properties - and type of relationships - appear in those maps as they would appear in the graph when the entity would have been written by SDN. Values will have the correct Cypher type and won’t need further conversion.
items.translation: 节点由一个映射表示。该映射始终包含 `__id__`，即映射的 id 属性。 在 `__labels__` 下，所有标签（静态和动态）均可访问。 所有属性以及关系类型均出现在这些映射中，其形式与实体由 SDN 写入图时呈现的形式一致。 值将具有正确的 Cypher 类型，无需进一步转换。

items.source: Assuming you have a query like MATCH (m:Movie{title: 'The Matrix'})←[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) return m,r,p that results into something like this:
items.translation: 假设您有一个查询，例如 `MATCH (m:Movie{title: 'The Matrix'})←[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) return m,r,p`，其结果如下所示：

items.source: The result from the mapping would be most likely unusable. If this would get mapped into a list, it will contain duplicates for the Movie but this movie will only have one relationship.
items.translation: 映射后的结果很可能无法使用。如果将其映射为列表，该列表中会出现多个Movie的重复项，但该电影实际上只有一个关联关系。

items.source: Keeping in mind that Spring Data Neo4j can only properly process record based, the result for one entity instance needs to be in one record. Using Cypher’s path capabilities is a valid option to fetch all branches in the graph.
items.translation: 鉴于 Spring Data Neo4j 仅能正确处理基于记录的数据，单个实体实例的结果必须位于一条记录中。利用Cypher 的路径功能来获取图中所有分支是一个有效的选项。

items.source: This will result in multiple paths that are not merged within one record. It is possible to call collect(p) but Spring Data Neo4j does not understand the concept of paths in the mapping process. Thus, nodes and relationships needs to get extracted for the result.
items.translation: 这将导致生成多条未合并到同一条记录中的路径。 可以调用 `collect(p)`，但 Spring Data Neo4j 在映射过程中并不理解“路径”这一概念。 因此，需要提取节点和关系以获取结果。

items.source: Because there are multiple paths that lead from 'The Matrix' to another movie, the result still won’t be a single record. This is where Cypher’s reduce function comes into play.
items.translation: 由于从《黑客帝国》到另一部电影存在多条路径，结果仍然不会是单条记录。 这时就需要用到Cypher 的 reduce 函数了。

items.translation: 以及一个如映射所示的领域模型（为简洁起见，已省略构造函数和访问器）：

items.source: As you see, the relationships are only outgoing. Generated finder methods (including findById) will always try to match a root node to be mapped. From there on onwards, all related objects will be mapped. In queries that should return only one object, that root object is returned. In queries that return many objects, all matching objects are returned. Out- and incoming relationships from those objects returned are of course populated.
items.translation: 如您所见，这些关系仅为单向关联。生成的查找方法（包括 `findById`）将始终尝试匹配一个根节点以进行映射。从该根节点开始，所有相关对象都将被映射。对于仅返回单个对象的查询，将返回该根对象；而对于返回多个对象的查询，则返回所有匹配的对象。这些已返回对象的出向和入向关联关系自然也会被填充。

items.source: It follows the recommendation from Getting one record per root node and it works great for the leaf node you want to match here. However: That is only the case in all scenarios that return 0 or 1 mapped objects. While that query will populate all relationships like before, it won’t return all 4 objects.
items.translation: 这遵循了为根节点获取单条记录中的建议，并且对于您希望在此处匹配的叶节点效果极佳。然而：这种情况仅适用于返回 0 或 1 个映射对象的所有场景。虽然该查询会像之前一样填充所有关系，但它不会返回全部 4 个对象。

items.source: Here we do want to use the fact that the path p actually returns 3 rows with paths to all 4 nodes. All 4 nodes will be populated, linked together and returned.
items.translation: 这里我们确实希望利用路径p实际上返回包含到所有 4 个节点路径的 3 行这一事实。这 4 个节点都将被填充、相互链接并返回。

items.source: The literal extension can be used to make things like labels or relationship-types "dynamic" in custom queries. Neither labels nor relationship types can be parameterized in Cypher, so they must be given literal.
items.translation: `literal` 扩展可用于在自定义查询中使标签或关系类型等元素呈现“动态”特性。由于 Cypher 无法对标签或关系类型进行参数化，因此必须将其作为字面量提供。

items.source: Notice how we used standard parameter for the nameOrId: In most cases there is no need to complicate things here by adding a SpEL expression.
items.translation: 请注意我们如何使用标准参数作为 `nameOrId`：在大多数情况下，无需在此处通过添加 SpEL 表达式来使事情复杂化。

items.source: Spring’s property placeholders can be used in custom queries inside ${}.
items.translation: 在自定义查询中，可以在${}内使用 Spring 的属性占位符。

items.source:
Spring Data Neo4j, like all the other Spring Data modules, allows you to specify custom queries in you repositories.
Those come in handy if you cannot express the finder logic via derived query functions.
items.translation: 与所有其他 Spring Data 模块一样，Spring Data Neo4j 允许您在仓库中指定自定义查询。当无法通过派生查询函数表达查找逻辑时，这些自定义查询非常有用。

items.source: Because Spring Data Neo4j works heavily record-oriented under the hood, it is important to keep this in mind and not build up a result set with multiple records for the same "root node".
items.translation: 由于 Spring Data Neo4j 在底层主要采用面向记录的方式工作，因此需要牢记这一点，避免为同一个“根节点”构建包含多条记录的結果集。

items.source: With this result as a single record it is possible for Spring Data Neo4j to add all related nodes correctly to the root node.
items.translation: 有了这一结果作为单条记录，Spring Data Neo4j 即可将所有相关节点正确添加到根节点。

items.source:
The example above assumes that you are only trying to fetch the first level of related nodes.
This is sometimes not enough and there are maybe nodes deeper in the graph that should also be part of the mapped instance.
There are two ways to achieve this: Database-side or client-side reduction.
items.translation:
上述示例假设您仅需获取第一级关联节点。  
有时这还不够，图中可能存在更深层的节点也应包含在映射实例中。  
实现这一目标有两种方式：数据库端缩减或客户端缩减。

items.source:
If the reduction should happen on the client-side, Spring Data Neo4j enables you to map also lists of lists of relationships or nodes.
Still, the requirement applies that the returned record should contain all information to hydrate the resulting entity instance correctly.
items.translation: 如果需要在客户端执行缩减操作，Spring Data Neo4j 允许您映射关系或节点的列表的列表。不过，返回的记录仍需包含所有必要信息，以便正确填充生成的实体实例。

items.source: Those lists will now get converted during the mapping process into a flat list.
items.translation: 这些列表将在映射过程中被转换为一个扁平列表。

items.source:
If an entity has a relationship with the same type to different types of others nodes, they will all appear in the same list.
If you need such a mapping and also have the need to work with those custom parameters, you have to unroll it accordingly.
One way to do this are correlated subqueries (Neo4j 4.1+ required).
items.translation:
如果某个实体与不同类型的其他节点具有相同类型的关系，它们将全部出现在同一个列表中。  
如果您需要这样的映射，并且还需要处理这些自定义参数，则必须对其进行相应的展开。  
实现此目标的一种方法是使用相关子查询（需要 Neo4j 4.1 或更高版本）。

items.source: Deciding if you want to go with client-side or database-side reduction depends on the amount of data that will get generated. All the paths needs to get created in the database’s memory first when the reduce function is used. On the other hand a large amount of data that needs to get merged on the client-side results in a higher memory usage there.
items.translation: 选择使用客户端还是数据库端进行归约，取决于将生成的数据量。 当使用 reduce 函数时，所有路径都需要先在数据库内存中创建。 另一方面，需要在客户端合并的大量数据会导致该处的内存使用量更高。

items.source: All relationships are lists of maps. Dynamic relationships will be resolved accordingly. One-to-one relationships will also be serialized as singleton lists. So to access a one-to-one mapping between people, you would write this das $person.__properties__.BEST_FRIEND[0].__target__.__id__.
items.translation: 所有关系都是映射列表。动态关系将据此解析。一对一的关系也将被序列化为单例列表。因此，要访问两个人之间的一对一映射，您需要这样编写：$person.__properties__.BEST_FRIEND[0].__target__.__id__。
